evals.name: orders-api-performance
evals.prompt: The orders API and dashboard feel slow. Make them faster, but show your measurements and reasoning. Do not guess.
evals.expected_output: Defines a budget, requires a baseline, identifies the N+1 loop and SELECT *, recommends batching/joins, indexes, pagination, and proves the win before/after.
assertions: Requires a baseline measurement before optimizing
Identifies the N+1 query loop in /api/orders
Recommends batching/join and selecting only needed columns
Considers pagination, indexes, and payload size
Does not add caching as the first fix without measurement
Proposes before/after verification with realistic data
